integrity: The published substitution and its previously known 2-binomial-cube avoidance are credited; new contribution is the exact Abelian window recursion and scale-restricted distributions.
scientific_limitations: All-scale statements apply only to block lengths 3^k with k >= 0 in the specified fixed point. The local checker tests finitely many positions and scales; other lengths and independent priority certification are outside scope.
title: Three-adic renormalization of Abelian repetitions in a 2-binomial-cube-free binary word
